statement.zh: 古蜀国考古遗址群在本登记时点仍走 UNESCO 预备清单文档路径，不等于已列入世界遗产。
statement.en: Ancient Shu archaeological sites remain on a UNESCO Tentative List documentation path at registration time — not the same as World Heritage inscription.
